title: Manslaughter
key_points: Aggravated: recklessly causing death under circumstances showing extreme indifference to human life, or causing death while eluding police.
Manslaughter: recklessly causing death, or a homicide that would be murder but is committed in the heat of passion after reasonable provocation.
elements: The suspect caused the victim's death
Manslaughter: the suspect acted recklessly (or in the heat of passion after reasonable provocation)
Aggravated manslaughter: recklessly, under circumstances showing extreme indifference to human life (or while eluding police)

subsections.label: a(1)
subsections.text: Aggravated manslaughter: recklessly causes death under circumstances manifesting extreme indifference to human life

subsections.label: a(2)
subsections.text: Aggravated manslaughter: causes death while fleeing or attempting to elude police

subsections.label: b(2)
subsections.text: Manslaughter: a homicide that would be murder but is committed in the heat of passion from reasonable provocation
